propositions: Completion verification fails verdict-less when primary run exhausts budget, hits runaway loops, or exhausts tokens despite banked criterion verdicts.
Per-criterion recovery fan-out generates up to 440 redundant requests (22 criteria × 20-request budget) with massive context re-send overhead.
Static 100k-char recovery context ceiling rejects valid tickets like c9f7 (121,147 chars) that fit the model's actual context window.
Duplicate read-only tool calls within a single agentic run repeat identically (observed 144x repeated search_files) without memoization or model steering.
Recovery context pre-loading of ranked file_impact contents reduces distinct file reads by 67-82% but requires budgeted request integration.
Verification workflow must guarantee full-coverage verdicts for all runs with banked progress while preserving zero-billable-call refusal invariants.
